challenges.title: A todo repository with a sealed Result
challenges.prompt: Implement TaskRepo.add (reject blank titles, trim, assign ids), complete (copy the task with done = true, or an error for unknown ids) and summary using partition. Results are a sealed Result type handled with an exhaustive when.
challenges.expected:
ok: Task(id=1, title=write quiz, done=false)
error: title must not be blank
ok: Task(id=2, title=publish, done=false)
ok: Task(id=1, title=write quiz, done=true)
error: no task with id 9
open=[publish] done=[write quiz]
challenges.explain: A sealed Result makes failure explicit and forces callers to handle every case, data classes give copy for immutable updates, and partition splits done/open in one pass. Verified by compiling and running the solution with kotlinc.
